name: Mercy Of God The
overview: The mercy of God is revealed as a gracious and longsuffering attribute central to His character, demonstrated in His abundant goodness and truth toward sinners. Scripture shows that God's mercy is both a ground of hope and trust, as seen in His preservation of Lot (Genesis 19:16, 19) and His promise to forgive iniquity while maintaining justice (Exodus 34:6-7; Numbers 14:18). The mercy seat, made of pure gold (Exodus 25:17), symbolizes God's presence and mercy extended to His people, highlighting mercy as a divine delight and an enduring aspect of salvation.
